title: The normalized slice comparisons preserve the evaluation counit
statement: Under the independent-universe ringed-site hypotheses and closed structures S,S_U with canonical representative models T,T_U [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], let d be slice comparison data [def-sfb-ringed-slice-comparison-model]. Assume only its pure-tensor normalization and local Hom-family normalization. For every pair L,M in D(A), the tensor-Hom counits satisfy rho(H(L,M),L)^(-1) followed by r(ev(L,M)) = (eta(L,M) tensor identity) followed by ev_U(rL,rM). This statement does not construct d, assert transpose compatibility, or use either Koszul normalization.

source.place: Tags 08J9 (lemma-internal-hom and equation-internal-hom), 08JB (lemma-restriction-RHom-to-U), and canonical complex evaluation in lemma-compose.

proof.text: Evaluation is natural in an isomorphism e:P≅L and a target map g:Q→M: tensor(H(e.inv,g),e.hom) followed by ev(L,M) equals ev(P,Q) followed by g. This follows from the source extranaturality field of the closed structure, naturality of the adjunction counit in the target, functoriality of tensor and H, and e.hom≫e.inv=identity.

Using this identity on both categories and simultaneous naturality of rho and eta, transport a normalized evaluation square along isomorphisms in both arguments. Precompose by tensor(rH(e.inv,eprime.hom),r(e.hom)), an isomorphism. Naturality of rho moves its inverse to the left, evaluation naturality identifies the left side with restricted old evaluation followed by r(eprime.hom), and eta naturality plus slice evaluation naturality identifies the right side with old slice evaluation followed by the same map. Apply the old square and cancel only the precomposed isomorphism.

Choose complex representatives X,Y of L,M. Take a flat-term K-flat resolution P→X and the fixed functorial K-injective replacement I of Y. Their augmentations are quasi-isomorphisms, so localization supplies Q(P)≅L and Q(I)≅M. Convert the resolution theorem's exactness-of-tensor-right property to the recorded flatness using siteSheafTensorRightIso. Apply the representative evaluation theorem to P,I and the preceding transport lemma to the two isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08J9 and 08JB. The representative computation is separate; the Lean proof constructs resolutions and proves categorical transport to arbitrary objects.

theorem ringedSlice_evaluation_coherence
    (U : C) [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose (J.over U) (forget₂
      CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj (A.over U)))]
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A))
    (T : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, c, v, w} J A S)
    (SU : CoefficientClosedStructure
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)))
    (TU : CoefficientTensorModels.{u, max c v, v, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U) SU)
    (d : RingedSliceEvaluationComparisons (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A)
      (derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U))
      (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U) S SU (RingedSliceFlatRestriction.{c, v,
      u} J A U))
      (ht : RingedSliceTensorModel.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U S T SU TU d)
      (hh : RingedSliceHomModel.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U S T SU TU d)
      (L M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂
        CommRingCat.{max c v u} RingCat.{max c v u})).obj A))) :
    (d.rho ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A).obj (op L, M)) L).inv ≫
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).map
            (S.evaluation L M) =
      SU.tensor.map (X := ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj
        ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{c, v, u, w} J A).obj (op L, M)),
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj L)) (Y :=
        ((derivedInternalHomOfUniverses.{max c v, v, u, w'} (J.over U) (A.over U)).obj (op
        ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj L),
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj M),
        (ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj L)) ((d.eta L M).hom, 𝟙 _) ≫
        SU.evaluation
          ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj L)
          ((ringedSliceDerivedRestriction.{c, v, u, w, w'} J A U).obj M)
